conviction_note: Near non-result: the Q1 (Jun-Aug 2026) quarter carries several property settlements bunched at end-August, all but one small land sale already inside the FY range guide, the company said on 2026-08-31 it does not plan to revise, no IFIS consensus exists, and the buyback/return pattern puts new returns at the H1 and FY prints rather than Q1. So the findings sum to +0.5 and the scaled number is +0.18 (p_up 53 x abs 3.0). The two measurements agree in sign; the gap is because the scaled number carries the crowded margin long (信用倍率 24) and a 12% slide from the August high, which can sell a fine quarter.
bar: Company FY2027 range guide (no IFIS consensus: kabuyoho/IFIS consensus field blank as of 2026-10-14, https://kabuyoho.jp/sp/reportAnalyst?bcode=8887): sales 38.0-40.0bn yen, OP 3.70-3.90bn, ordinary profit 2.375-2.50bn (2026-07-15 決算短信, https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260715/140120260715594530.pdf). Q1 bar = last year's own Q1 progress: Q1 FY26 ordinary profit 452m = 22% of the FY26 actual 2,067m (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20251015/140120251015573931.pdf), i.e. ~535m against the 2.44bn midpoint. Single company-sourced bar, no second estimate source, so every size is capped small.
positioning_check: JPX short register 2026-10-14: no disclosed position >=0.5% (short_ratio 0.0, change 0.0) per baseline (https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html). 信用倍率 24.24 (scraped, baseline): margin long heavily crowded. No options, no skew. findings.finding: Q1 FY2027 (Jun-Aug 2026) carries a cluster of disclosed settlements: 品川区西大井 apartments (settled 2026-08-28), 川崎市幸区 building and 台東区東上野 48-unit apartment block (both settled 2026-08-31), each at or above 10% of FY25 standalone sales (>=~540m yen), plus the 新子安PJ (76 units, completed 2026-07) and 立川II (22 units, 2026-08) completions on the FY26 presentation's schedule, so Q1 deliveries look at least as heavy as last year's Q1 (segment sales 7,465m, 22% of FY ordinary profit).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 FY26 (2026-04-14, 13:00, ordinary profit already above the FY plan) drew about -2.2% (baseline, estimated date); Q2 (2026-01-14, 上期経常が黒字浮上, kabutan サプライズ決算) about +4.0%. A strong quarter has been both bought and sold here.
findings.why_not_priced: Every settlement was disclosed on TDnet, and each says its revenue and profit are already inside the FY2027 guide, so the money is not unpriced. What the market has not seen is the quarter's total and margin (sale prices are undisclosed, and with the 2026-07 to 2026-08 completions the Q1 progress rate cannot be computed from public data). If the market had marked Q1 strong you would expect the stock to hold its August level; instead it slid 12% from 389 to 344, which is consistent with nobody positioning for the quarter. Sized near zero because it lands inside the guide.
findings.independence: Same company, different documents: 2026-08-28 settlement (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260828/140120260828527861.pdf), 2026-08-31 Kawasaki settlement (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260831/140120260831528644.pdf), and the completion schedule in the FY26 presentation (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260715/140120260715594526.pdf). All are company disclosures, not an independent series.

findings.finding: Two Q1-dated items sit OUTSIDE the FY2027 guide: a 横浜市南区新川町 land sale settled 2026-08-31 that the company states is 'not included in the FY2027 forecast' and is booked in Q1 (with a construction contract for the buyer's 9-storey building recognised over 2026-02 to 2027-08), and a 62m yen river-works compensation (non-operating income, also unguided, 'minor'). The company added on 2026-08-31 that it does not currently plan to revise the forecast.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The FY26 guide was raised twice (2025-10-15 net profit on negative goodwill, +8.7% next day; 2026-05-20 ordinary profit +48%, stock turned positive intraday per kabutan). One consolidated year of history only.
findings.why_not_priced: Public, but the amounts are undisclosed (a 167 sq m plot, so small against a 2.4bn ordinary-profit guide) and the company has said no revision is planned. It only matters if Q1 is strong enough that management narrows the range to the upper end; the explicit no-revision statement makes that unlikely, hence near 0.
findings.independence: Koshigaya compensation, separate document: https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260717/140120260717596044.pdf (2026-07-17). Both company documents.

outside_window.finding: Third stock-option tranche (exercise price 73 yen) had its exercise window extended two years, with holders agreeing to exercise actively from 2027-04-30: a dilution and funding source dated well after this window.
草加 land-readjustment compensation of 697m yen (non-operating income, included in the FY guide) with a hand-over deadline of 2027-03-31: likely recognised later in the year, not in Q1.

bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: not expected (company said on 2026-08-31 'no revision planned'; the range guide was set for Hormuz risk to H2 completions). Returns: not expected at Q1 by the company's own pattern; 14 yen dividend (7 interim) already guided under a progressive-dividend policy. New-year guide: n/a (Q1). Quarter vs own 進捗率: last Q1 = 22% of FY ordinary profit; this Q1 has heavy August settlements, so it is probably at or above that, but unverifiable.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Last year's Q1 reaction of +8.7% as a precedent for this print
rejected_candidates.detail: That move was driven by a one-off negative-goodwill net-profit revision (2025-10-15) that the FY2027 短信 says has dropped out; it does not recur.

baseline_tension: The findings lean slightly positive against a slightly negative priced lean (-0.50, driven by the 24x margin-long overhang) and a -3.9% 20-day slide. The strongest positive the release could carry is a narrowing of the range toward the top, or a new buyback (the last finished 2026-08-20); I looked for both and found no evidence for either at a Q1 print. The strongest negative is the crowded margin long selling a fine quarter, as on the 2026-04-14 Q3 print.
lessons_applied: nothing changed: LESSONS.md rules 1-2 concern negatives built on visible 月次 misses and a negative tilt; both findings here are small positives already sized toward 0 for landing inside the guide, and rule 2's check (strongest positive: buyback/range narrowing) was already done and written in baseline_tension
